off = 8
# parse attributes until empty name
while True:

    name = data[off:end].decode('ascii', errors='replace')
    off = end + 1
    # read type (null-terminated)
    end = data.index(b'\x00', off)
    typ = data[off:end].decode('ascii', errors='replace')
    off = end + 1
    # read size (4 bytes)
    size = int.from_bytes(data[off:off+4], 'little')
    off += 4
    val = data[off:off+size]
    off += size
    print(f"attr: name={name!r} type={typ!r} size={size} val_hex={val.hex()}")
    if name == '':
        break
print("Header ends at offset:", off)
print("Remaining bytes:", len(data) - off)
